I haven't set up the digest yet. My scheduler returned a gateway credentials error, so I can't create the recurring Monday job. I've posted a reply in #coastal-team explaining this.

Here's what I'd schedule once the scheduler works:

- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time (13:00 UTC), starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted in #coastal-team.
- **What:** last week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing in the digest would reach anyone who couldn't already see it.
- **Excluded:** money terms such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values and invoices, because the channel is shared. Operational facts like seat counts, renewal dates, licensed products and ticket numbers can go in.

Once you say yes and the scheduler is back, I'll create the job and post a test digest in #coastal-team so you can check it.
